{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] '''male''' held the title of [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Per the Thisspiasian tradition, in order to convince the Blood Monarch to lend military aid to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the conflict, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] fought the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarch]] in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] and bested [[Gender/Legends|him]], after which Rancisis' request was granted.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
